title: ChemE-as-Code: An Open-Source Platform for Agentic AI in Chemical Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.07947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ChemE-as-Code provides an open-source environment in which AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) can carry out chemical engineering work and engineers can check it. Its calculation tools range from catalysis through process simulation to plant layout, HAZOP and life cycle assessment, and skills tell a general-purpose agent how to use them. Engineering files are linked, machine-readable and versioned in Git; calculations run outside the LLM, each value records its origin, and automated checks report inconsistencies and out-of-date results by file and line. In an illustrative ammonia case, agents developed a written task into a preliminary basic-engineering package (simulation files, P&IDs, layout, HAZOP, datasheets, relief) for USD 224 of API cost in the design sessions. Planted faults and engineering changes show that the checks find what their rules cover and miss the rest, so they guide human review rather than replace it. No

translated_title: ChemE-as-Code：面向化学工程智能体AI的开源平台
translated_abstract: ChemE-as-Code提供了一个开源环境，基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的AI智能体可以在其中开展化学工程工作，而工程师能够对其进行核查。其计算工具涵盖从催化到过程模拟，再到工厂布置、危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP）以及生命周期评估，并通过“技能”告知通用智能体如何使用这些工具。工程文件相互关联、可被机器读取并在Git中进行版本管理；计算在LLM之外运行，每个数值都记录其来源，自动化检查能够按文件和行报告不一致及过期的结果。在一个示例性的合成氨案例中，智能体在若干次设计会话中，以224美元的API成本，将一项书面任务发展为初步的基础工程设计包（包括模拟文件、管道仪表流程图、布置图、HAZOP、数据表和泄放计算）。植入的故障和工程变更表明，这些检查能发现其规则所覆盖的问题，但会遗漏其余问题，因此它们的作用是引导人工审查，而非取代人工审查。
tldr: 该论文提出了开源平台ChemE-as-Code，让基于LLM的AI智能体在可追溯、可版本管理的环境中完成从催化到过程模拟、HAZOP等化学工程设计与计算工作，并通过自动化检查引导而非取代人工审查。
en_tdlr: ChemE-as-Code is an open-source platform that enables LLM-based AI agents to perform chemical engineering calculations and design in a traceable, version-controlled environment, with automated checks guiding rather than replacing human review.
